Every group get two bots:
• **Hanogt Security Bot** (you no fit remove am): e dey list the rules of the group Rules section, with numbers, with `/rules`, e dey show the welcome message and e dey announce moderation. Commands: `/help`, `/rules`, `/warnings` and `/report @person reason` for everybody; `/warn`, `/mute @person 10m reason` (28 days at most), `/unmute`, `/kick`, `/purge 20` and `/slowmode 10s` for moderators; `/ban` for owners and admins. Na only you fit see command replies. Dem dey keep warnings and reports for 180 days.
• **Hanogt AI**: ask with `/ai question` or `@Hanogt AI`; e dey read the last 12 messages for the channel, e dey answer for the group and e dey use your Hanogt AI message allowance. You fit off am for Group settings → Bots.
**AutoMod** (Group settings → Safety): rules for curse words, slang, the group own banned words, spam, too many mentions, links, capital letters and personal data (email, phone, Turkish ID, card, IBAN). Message wey break rule no go ever send; if the group choose, dem go give warning and after some number of warnings e go mute the person by itself. E no dey ever concern the owner, and e no dey concern admins by default. Owners and admins fit also set **custom commands** and **welcome message**.
